The macOS build succeeded; the failure is in the registry smoke test. macOS builds the core module, but `collision_freq` also needs the optional Vlasov module. The test only checks for core availability.

I’ll make that case respect its module requirement. It will still run in the full Linux build, which includes Vlasov.
